description: Returns a team's upcoming matches on the league schedule, or those of every team a player is on: the opponent, the day, the start time, and home or away. Call it for a next match, today's or tomorrow's match, or the schedule. Pass `team` for a named team, or `player` for a first-person ask like 'who am I playing'. It gives no team win chance. A team match's chance is only in the live playoff report from project_standings, which comes with the Desk Pass.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

player.description: Player whose teams' upcoming matches to fetch, e.g. 'First Last'. Or the player's Desk page link or number.

team.description: Team name to resolve, e.g. 'Belvedere mixed 8.0' or 'BELVEDERE TC 40MX8.0A'. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: query_team_forecast
title: Upcoming matches
